Name: Jaazaniah, Son of Shaphan
Summary: Jaazaniah, son of Shaphan, was one of the seventy elders of Israel whom Ezekiel saw in a vision standing in a dark chamber, each with a censer, burning incense to idols painted on the wall, saying that the Lord did not see them. He is a different man from Jaazaniah son of Azur and Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah.
KeyStory: In vision Ezekiel saw Jaazaniah son of Shaphan among seventy elders worshipping idols in the dark, each man with his censer in his hand.
LifeLesson: Secret idolatry by elders is not hidden from God, even when it is hidden from everyone else.
